title: Fake Tour Guide Deposit
scenario: A guide on social media asks for full payment by bank transfer for a popular tour.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Fake Tour Guide Deposit: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Use verified tour platforms or protected payment.
